results.title: Musk pledges SpaceX stock for ‘every kid in America’ as billionaires push direct donations
results.description: Elon Musk, the world’s richest man, said that he would give away one share of SpaceX, his rocket and artificial intelligence company, to “every kid in America” next year, in a social media post in the early hours of Monday. The post Musk pledges SpaceX stock for ‘every kid in America’ as billionaires push direct donations appeared first on West Hawaii Today.
